run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-16T22:35:20Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend-proxy is carried by traces_span_metrics_calls_total series that exist only for the frontend-proxy span_names 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress'. Two things are observed. First, the only real deviation in the window: from 22:25:46.285 to 22:27:29 the frontend-proxy access log recorded HTTP 500 on POST /api/checkout, and span error rates at 22:29:20 (5m window 22:24:20-22:29:20) were 0.2606/s on frontend 'POST /api/checkout', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder', and 0.1708/s on checkout 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and 'oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge'. That burst starts 1.3 s after the only payment pod (payment-55766d76b9-846r8) was told to stop at 22:25:45 as Deployment payment rolled out ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786 (config-only, same image tag), and ends when the new payment pod began serving charges (first charge log lines by 22:27:52). Deployment payment has readinessProbe null and RollingUpdate maxUnavailable 25% with one replica, so the serving replica was replaced before its replacement could serve. Second, a separate pre-existing pattern that is still present at the alert time: 503 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' on frontend-proxy GET routes at 22:16:16, 22:17:19, 22:18:36, 22:21:40 (before the burst) and at 22:27:54, 22:31:10, 22:33:47, 22:34:02, 22:34:35, 22:34:49, 22:37:33, 22:38:36 (after it); at 22:35:20 the frontend-proxy error rate was 0.0111/s on ingress only, and it stayed above zero through 22:44:20, which is what an 'above 0' alert would latch onto. Because the alert rule itself is not readable (Prometheus returned no rules at all) and the reported value 0.0222 does not match the 5-minute readings available, the link between the payment-rollout burst and the alert's exact firing instant is not proven; the payment rollout is therefore reported as the root cause of the error burst as a hypothesis, and the pre-existing 503 resets are reported as an unresolved second candidate.

claims.text: Error signal for frontend-proxy comes from traces_span_metrics_calls_total with status_code label values STATUS_CODE_ERROR / STATUS_CODE_OK / STATUS_CODE_UNSET; the only frontend-proxy series in the ERROR state are span_name 'ingress' and span_name 'router frontend egress'.

frontend-proxy 5-minute error-span rate (ingress) moved from 0.0037-0.0185 spans/s between 22:05:20 and 22:26:20 up to 0.1074 at 22:27:20, 0.2556 at 22:28:20, 0.2643 at 22:29:20, 0.2593 at 22:30:20 and 0.1519 at 22:31:20, then fell back to 0.0037-0.0151 through 22:44:20 and 0 at 22:45:20; 'router frontend egress' ERROR was non-zero only in the 22:27:20-22:31:20 points.

At 22:29:20 (rate window 22:24:20-22:29:20) the ERROR series were: frontend span_name 'POST /api/checkout', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout', 'POST' and 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' at 0.2606 spans/s each; checkout span_name 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and 'oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge' at 0.1708 spans/s each; frontend-proxy 'ingress' at 0.2593 and 'router frontend egress' at 0.2556 spans/s.

In the same 22:29:20 window, checkout's client span 'oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge' had ERROR 0.1708 spans/s and UNSET 0.3399 spans/s, while payment's own server span 'grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge' appears only as UNSET 0.1850 spans/s with no ERROR series, i.e. far fewer Charge calls reached payment than checkout attempted.

The frontend-proxy access log shows 'POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream' first at 2026-11-16T22:25:46.285Z and repeatedly until 22:27:29; the next frontend-proxy 5xx entries in that period are the 503 UC resets at 22:27:54 and 22:31:10, i.e. the 500 burst ended at 22:27:29.

otel-demo events show Deployment payment rolling its only replica: 'Scaled up replica set payment-54499f9786 from 0 to 1' and 'Created pod: payment-54499f9786-4r25d' at 22:25:42, 'Started container payment' at 22:25:45, 'Stopping container payment' for pod payment-55766d76b9-846r8 at 22:25:45, and 'Scaled down replica set payment-55766d76b9 from 1 to 0' at 22:25:45.

ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786 was created 2026-11-16T22:25:42Z with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment, the same image tag as the pre-existing payment-55766d76b9 (created 21:53:30, now replicas 0), so the change was a configuration-only rollout.

Deployment payment uses strategy RollingUpdate with maxSurge 25% and maxUnavailable 25%, has readinessProbe null, and the namespace holds exactly one payment pod, payment-54499f9786-4r25d (phase Running, ready true, restartCount 0, startTime 2026-11-16T22:25:42Z).

The replacement payment pod was serving charges shortly after the burst: its log has 'Charge request received.' / 'Transaction complete.' pairs from 22:27:52.670Z through 22:28:58Z, and checkout logged 'payment went through' and 'order placed' at 22:29:58Z.

A separate, pre-existing frontend-proxy error pattern exists: HTTP 503 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' on GET /api/products/*, /api/cart and /api/data/?contextKeys=* at 22:16:16.273Z, 22:17:19.272Z, 22:18:36.321Z and 22:21:40.657Z (before the payment rollout burst) and again at 22:27:54.903Z, 22:31:10.215Z, 22:33:47.051Z, 22:34:02.791Z, 22:34:35.826Z, 22:34:49.351Z, 22:37:33.816Z and 22:38:36.351Z.

At the alert's start instant 22:35:20 the frontend-proxy 5-minute error rate was 0.011111 spans/s on 'ingress' and 0 on 'router frontend egress' (the checkout 500 burst had already ended at 22:27:29), and the rate stayed above 0 (0.013-0.015 at 22:36:20-22:38:20, 0.0117 at 22:43:20, 0.0084 at 22:44:20) before reading 0 at 22:45:20.

Of the services whose error series were returned, accounting and payment read 0 error spans throughout, and ad and fraud-detection were non-zero only on span_name 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' at 0.0037 spans/s in the 22:20:20, 22:30:20 and 22:40:20 points (a flag-stream pattern, not on the checkout path); services whose series were not returned remain unknown.

All 21 otel-demo pods are Running with ready containers, restartCount 0 and no lastState termination reason (no OOMKilled, no Evicted); the only pod created during the window is payment-54499f9786-4r25d, and frontend-675fd7b5c5-zjtpt, frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-sznks and checkout-5dccddf8bb-h9bvp date from 21:53:30/21:53:31.

The flagd-config ConfigMap (read at 22:53) holds flag 'paymentUnreachable' with defaultVariant 'on' ('Payment service is unavailable') and 'paymentFailure' with defaultVariant 'off'; every other fault flag (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) is 'off'.

Most likely cause of the error burst: Deployment otel-demo/payment was rolled at 22:25:42 (new ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786, same image) and terminated the sole serving payment pod at 22:25:45 while its replacement had no readiness gate (readinessProbe null), leaving checkout's PlaceOrder-with-Charge path failing from 22:25:46 to 22:27:29; those failures surfaced as frontend 500 on POST /api/checkout and as frontend-proxy 'ingress'/'router frontend egress' error spans at up to 0.26 spans/s.

Second, unresolved candidate for the alert's firing state at and after 22:35:20: the pre-existing sporadic frontend-proxy 503 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' resets on GET routes keep the frontend-proxy error rate strictly above zero (0.0111 spans/s at 22:35:20, still 0.0084 at 22:44:20), which is sufficient for an 'above 0' RequestErrorRate alert; the resets predate the payment rollout (22:16-22:21) and their origin inside frontend is not established.

Rejected: that flag 'paymentUnreachable'='on' (the only enabled payment-related fault flag) caused the Charge failures. Charges completed successfully at 22:27:52-22:28:58 in the same cluster state where that ConfigMap value reads 'on', 'paymentFailure' is 'off', and the failures are confined to the ~105 s window that starts 1.3 s after the payment pod was stopped and end when the replacement pod began serving; the failing Charge calls are client-side (checkout ERROR 0.1708/s) with far fewer payment server Charge spans (0.1850/s) than checkout attempts (0.51/s). The flag's value during the incident is unknown (ConfigMap read at 22:53 only).

The 500 burst is not explained by a frontend, frontend-proxy or checkout restart or crash: those pods date from 21:53:30-21:53:31, have restartCount 0 and no lastState termination reason, and no otel-demo Pod events other than payment's Created/Started/Killing appear in the window.

Give payment (and the other single-replica otel-demo services) a readiness probe (e.g. the gRPC health check) and use maxUnavailable 0 for 1-replica Deployments, so a rolling update cannot remove the only serving payment replica before its replacement accepts calls.

Investigate separately the recurring 503 'upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' between frontend-proxy (Envoy) and frontend on GET routes, typically an upstream keep-alive/idle-timeout race; it is the error source present at the alert's own evaluation time.

Retrieve the RequestErrorRate alerting rule (it is not present in the Prometheus the tools queried) to confirm the expression behind 'current: 0.0222' and whether it is a rate per second or a ratio, and confirm the intended semantics of flagd flag 'paymentUnreachable'='on'.

gaps: Alerting rule cannot be read: list_prometheus_rules returned no rules at all (both with rule_name=RequestErrorRate and unfiltered), so the alert's expression, threshold, evaluation window and 'pending' duration are unknown, and the reported current value 0.0222 does not match any 5-minute error-rate reading available (0.011111 spans/s on frontend-proxy 'ingress' at 22:35:20).

Jaeger returned no traces after 22:21:12 for the queried services: traces_search for frontend-proxy over 21:35:20-22:51:49 only returned traces starting 22:21:07-22:21:12, and searches over 22:26:00-22:34:00 (frontend-proxy, frontend) and 22:25:00-22:40:00 (checkout, tag error=true) returned no traces, so the failing requests' trace graph and the exact gRPC status returned to checkout/frontend could not be inspected.

The terminated payment pod payment-55766d76b9-846r8 no longer exists, so its logs are unavailable; log reads of the replacement pod for 22:25:45-22:26:05 and 22:26:40-22:27:00 returned no lines, which is unknown rather than proof that no requests were served.

The frontend container emitted no readable log lines for 22:20:00-22:40:00, so the reason frontend answered 500 on /api/checkout and why frontend reset upstream connections (503 UC) could not be read; checkout logged no error-level lines at all (error-filtered read over the whole window matched 0 of 7753 lines).

Change history is not an integrated data source in this Run, so what changed in the Deployment payment pod template at 22:25:42 (and who applied it) is unknown; the Deployment now has readinessProbe null and the same image tag as the previous ReplicaSet, which shows a configuration-only rollout but not its content.

Flag values during the incident are unknown: flagd-config was read at 22:53 only, and how flag 'paymentUnreachable'='on' is consumed by the payment service in image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment could not be verified.

No ERROR metric series was returned for cart, currency, product-catalog, email, shipping, image-provider, quote, kafka and load-generator, so their error state is unknown rather than zero; span counts in traces_span_metrics_calls_total are span counts, not unique request counts.

Events in namespace data-recorders (FailedScheduling, VolumeFailedDelete, PVC provisioning) and the PersistentVolume VolumeFailedDelete are present in the same authorized window but no evidence ties them to the otel-demo request errors, so they are left out of the conclusion.
next_steps: Add a gRPC readinessProbe to Deployment otel-demo/payment and set maxUnavailable 0 for single-replica services so rollouts cannot drop the only serving replica.

Load the RequestErrorRate alerting rule into the queried Prometheus (or supply the rule file) to verify its expression, threshold and lookback, since the reported current value cannot be reproduced from the available series.

Investigate the recurring 503 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' between frontend-proxy and frontend: compare Envoy upstream keep-alive/idle timeouts with the Next.js server's connection handling and add frontend access/error logging.
Confirm whether flagd flag 'paymentUnreachable'='on' is intentional and which service consumes it; correlate flag changes with payment behaviour if flagd audit/change history can be enabled.

Enable change history for the cluster so the payment Deployment template change at 22:25:42 can be attributed, and consider gRPC retry/backoff on checkout's PaymentService client to shorten the reconnect window after pod replacement.
